t.zh: 刚才读标识符时，试的是开头没有填充位的帧。换一条消息，连续相同的位之间会多出一位：发送方每说完连续五个相同的位，就插入一个相反的位。
t.en: The identifiers read so far had no stuff bits at the start. Other messages contain an extra bit: after five equal bits in a row, the sender inserts one opposite bit.

t.zh: 接收方要跳过填充位。注意，填充位本身也算线上连续位的第一位；后面若再有四位与它相同，又要跳过下一位。
t.en: The receiver skips the stuff bit. The stuff bit itself starts the next run on the line; if four more bits match it, the following bit is stuffed too.

desc.zh: 从一段从头开始的填充位串中跳过填充位；该拍交出「—」。每块有自己的寄存卡。
desc.en: Skips stuff bits in a stuffed stream starting at its beginning, giving 「—」 on those ticks. Each part has its own registers.

after.zh: 数的是线上连续的位，包括被跳过的填充位。
after.en: The run is counted on the line, including the stuff bit that was skipped.

brief.zh: 输入是一段从第一位开始、已经填充的位串。每拍交出原位；若这一位是填充位，就交出「—」。
brief.en: The input is a stuffed bit stream from its first bit. Give out the bit each tick, or 「—」 if it is a stuff bit.

hint.zh: 记住上一拍的位和连着相同的位数。
hint.en: Remember the previous bit and the length of its run.

hint.zh: 上一拍刚数到五，这一拍就是填充位；仍要把它记作新的一段的第一位。
hint.en: If the run reached five on the previous tick, this tick is stuffed; still count it as the first bit of the next run.
